source.name: Toyota Motor Corporation / TOYOTA RACING GmbH – Toyota’s European R&D center changes its name and competes in WEC with a new brand
source.quote: Starting from the 2026 season, the team will participate under the new brand "TOYOTA RACING" and will introduce the updated "TR010 HYBRID" Hypercar.

summary: 2026 TR010 HYBRID campaign: Toyota's WEC factory team now runs under the manufacturer brand TOYOTA RACING (renamed from TOYOTA GAZOO Racing in January 2026). Its 26 official partners are listed in the team's 2026 WEC media kit and on the team's partners page. Michelin is the WEC-wide tyre supplier (also shown among the partners) and is excluded.
